title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single face with one loop. The loop should be composed of four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0452); the third line starts at (0.75, 0.0452) and ends at (0.0, 0.0452); the fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.0452) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Finally, extrude the transformed sketch 0.0075 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The resulting shape is a rectangular base with a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.0452 units, and a height of 0.0075 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new 2D sketch on the XY plane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Add the lines to create a rectangle
r = (
    r.lineTo(0.75, 0.0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0452)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0452)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0)  # line_4
    .close()  # close the loop to create a rectangle
)

# Extrude the rectangle in the Z direction by the given depth
r = r.extrude(0.0075)

# Final model represented as 'r'
